Name: Muscular Farmer Body
Author: undare
Description:
[b][size=3]Lifting [color=#ff7700]things[/color], cutting [color=#00ff00]trees[/color], smashing [color=#cccccc]rocks [/color]has paid off!!!


This is a mod for the [color=#ffd966]male farmer[/color] and his [color=#f6b26b]Bald variant[/color]. [b][size=3](Added support for [color=#d5a6bd]female[/color]farmer too)[/size][/b]  (in 1.4 update there are 2 models in the files now. A Bald one being just added for both male and female )  

In the [color=#00ffff]config [/color]file added after launching the game for the first time you can change 5 options :

"[color=#00ffff]RevealingBody[/color]": "true"          (or false)
true  =   Your undershirt will be gone. ([color=#f1c232]only for Male Farmer![/color])
Default  "true"


[b][size=3]"[color=#00ffff]FemaleArms[/color]": "false"          (or true)        [color=#ffff00] [/color]
[b][size=3]true  =   [color=#d5a6bd]Female [/color]models will have muscular arms[/size][/b]
Default "false"


"[color=#00ffff]BuffedLegs[/color]" : "true"                [b][size=3][b][color=#f1c232][size=3]New![/size][/color][/b][/size][/b]
true = Legs will be wider
Default "true"
[b][size=3][b][size=3][color=#00ff00]Note[/color]: Dont use Skinny leg pants..  Is the only conflict[/size][/b][/size][/b]


"[color=#00ffff]BareFeet[/color]": "false"                    [b][size=3][b][color=#f1c232][size=3]New![/size][/color][/b][/size][/b]
true = NO SHOES!.. Farmer bareFeet instead. 
Default "false"


"[color=#00ffff]NoUndies[/color]": "false"                   [color=#f1c232] [b][size=3][b][size=3]New![/size][/b][/size][/b][/color]
true = You guessed it!..  
Default "false"  (of course)


"[color=#00ffff]BodyHair[/color]": "none"                    [b][size=3][b][color=#f1c232][size=3]New![/size][/color][/b][/size][/b]
[b][size=3][b][size=3][color=#ff7700]WARNING[/color]!! :  This Overlaps with the shirts. So if you choose any bodyhair,, you will need to take of your shirt.[/size][/b][/size][/b]
([color=#f1c232]New image showing these above and inside mod folder[/color].)
none= nothing
small = little treasure trail
medium = medium sized
mediumsoft = more like stuble in the chest
full = full furry chest
[color=#c27ba0]Minor Conflict [/color]:
-Some headgear like the Knight Helmet, will hide the bodyhair.
-The bodyhair will NOT show on the character creation or Character selection menu. (This happens because i locked the bodyhair just for male characters, and the gender is not shown on those 2 menus---  weird, right? )

[/size][/b]
Install :
Unzip it, and drop it inside your Mods folder in your SDV directory.

Requires Smapi and Content Patcher.
